# Sandeep More Institute of Technology (SMIT) — AI-Powered LMS Platform

> Sandeep More Institute of Technology (SMIT) is a virtual classroom platform with WebRTC live rooms, collaborative whiteboards, and AI study tools.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://live-meet.onrender.com/): SMIT landing page and feature highlights.
- [Browse Courses](https://live-meet.onrender.com/browse): Catalog of interactive courses across technology, business, and engineering.

## API Documentation
- [Auth API](https://live-meet.onrender.com/api/auth/me): Authentication endpoints and session status.
- [Courses API](https://live-meet.onrender.com/api/courses): Public course discovery and curriculum data.

## System Architecture
- [System Manifest](https://live-meet.onrender.com/site.webmanifest): Application metadata and icons.
- [Robots Rules](https://live-meet.onrender.com/robots.txt): Search engine crawler specifications.
